AI Overview
Play Word500 online to guess a hidden five-letter word in 8 attempts or less using a twist on the classic Wordle formula. 
Word500

How Word500 Works
Goal: Decode a 5-letter secret word in 8 tries or fewer. 
Color Feedback: Instead of showing you where the matching letters go, Word500 only tells you how many match:
Green: Right letter in the right spot.
Yellow: Right letter in the wrong spot.
Red / Absent: Letter is not in the word.
